messages:
jess: Quick note 1: were enacting a targeted release pause starting 20:00 UTC for 10 hours (20:00 06:00 UTC). Purpose: reduce blast radius before the infra maintenance window. No cross-region promotions or global model swaps during this window. Canaries allowed in canary regions only.

ryan: Does this also pause scheduled infra migrations?

jess: Yes - postpone any host-level migrations that touch production routing. You can run validation in staging/canary but do not promote. If you absolutely need an exception, follow the emergency promo flow (tag `release:expedite` and get 2 approvers + one SRE ack).

kim: SRE changes planned: lock autoscaler min to current pool sizes, disable aggressive upscaling rules, and flip ingress batching to conservative. Ill apply at 19:45 UTC and monitor for 30m.

maya: Runtime: hold all KV cache flushes that are scheduled to run during the window. If your job is idempotent and safe, mark the CI job `non-blocking` and reschedule for after 06:00.

jess: Canary monitoring thresholds were using for automated fallback:
- latency increase > 12% sustained for 4m triggers fallback
- error rate > 1.5% for 3m triggers fallback
- request drop > 0.5% for 2m triggers investigation

jess: Applied canary config to the release controller:```yaml
canary:
  regions: ["us-east-1-canary", "eu-west-1-canary"]
  promotion: manual
  auto_fallback: true
  thresholds:
    latency_pct: 12
    error_pct: 1.5
    drop_pct: 0.5
```

deploy-bot: Attempted promotion of `model-x-1.3.0` at 20:08 UTC 1: PROMOTION BLOCKED: targeted release pause in effect.

ops-bot: Canary health checks active 1: alerting window open.

ryan: Are Dedicated customers affected? We have two tenants with scheduled maintenance tonight.

kim: Dedicated pools: ops will coordinate per-tenant comms. Were not forcing downtime, but we will prevent any config promos that change serving topology without explicit customer ok. If a customer needs the change, open an emergency-approval ticket.

maya: Heads-up: if your rollout depends on quant-plugin changes, please stage to canary first and hold on global promotion. The last freeze we had a cache priming surge at 02:30 UTC that caused transient 5xxs.

jess: Action checklist:
- All teams: review scheduled promotions between 20:00-06:00 UTC; cancel or mark `release:freeze`.
- @kim: apply autoscaler and batching changes (19:45 UTC).
- @maya: audit scheduled cache/priming jobs and tag/reschedule.
- Release leads: no cross-region promos until 06:00 UTC.

jess: If you run into a critical customer-facing regression that requires an immediate fix, follow the expedite flow. Otherwise, please respect the pause so we can get the maintenance window in smoothly. Ill post a short debrief at 07:00 UTC with any fallout and lessons learned. :slightly_smiling_face:
